title: Design deterministic NPC action VM
goal: Create the Worker-safe replacement for common gmsv NPC script behavior before considering Lua/WASM compatibility.
source: docs/planning/WORKER_NATIVE_GMSV_PORT.md, external/sources/gmsv/npc, gmsv-data/npc args/templates

notes: Started 2026-05-12. Existing deterministic NPC branches now emit structured npcVmEvents for say, quest, shop, window, warp, heal, save, setFlag, give, take, startBattle, battleAction, debug, and unsupported actions; dialog debug exposes action profile, allowedActions, supportedActions, recent vmTrace, and save JSON carries recent VM events. AI NPC prompt now receives allowedActions and recentTrace but may not mutate state directly. Stateful setFlag/give/take/startBattle/battleAction now run through runNpcVmAction, mutate flags/stone/exp/inventory/encounter/battle state in the NPC VM executor, and mark executor:npc-action-vm plus mutated trace detail. Latest slices add a shared source-style condition evaluator for NPC/warp/script EVENT conditions covering LV, ITEM, ENDEV/NOWEV, STONE, PET/PETCOUNT, MANOR, CLASS, and TRANS tokens, then add source changeevent givePet/takePet mutations for GetPet/DelPet through the same VM. Next: move more handlers behind the declarative action dispatcher. 2026-05-14 slice adds source changeevent GetRandItem/GetStone/DelStone support through the same VM: random item pools keep duplicate IDs as weighted candidates, stone give/take uses VM give/take with source reasons, LV* multiplier costs are evaluated from player level, and StoneFullMsg/StoneLessMsg/PetFullMsg are parsed for source-style blocked replies. Numbered source dialogue pages now stay compactly parsed as messagePages instead of being dropped or dumped raw, and runtime formatting fills source %8d stone-cost placeholders from the validated event cost.

The arena/hero battlefield map-sampler quest is now playerFacing:false/full-dev only; build hooks, npcQuestIds, and AI available-quest context keep it out of the default player chain while leaving the data available for source audit.

First slices add an original-client-style map command dock plus a compact player/pet status HUD on the map surface; command buttons control pet/task/log/save/data/AI panels while HP/level/stone/inventory stay visible in play. The top-left/top-right field menu now uses original atlas sprite IDs from anim_tbl.h/field.cpp rather than CSS-drawn stand-ins, and the temporary player character uses original SPR_001em stand/walk bitmap frames from spr_115.bin with step-time redraws.
